title: Add a session to My Plans and arrange booking with the provider
summary: Record intended attendance and arrange registration directly with the provider.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Record a plan, then arrange attendance with the provider
paragraphs: My Plans records intended attendance. Adding a session does not reserve a place, register you or pay the provider.
Sign in to the account that will keep the personal plan. The Programme/service must be saved and have a current active dated session available to plan.
steps: Save the Programme/service, then open Care Calendar → Calendar.
On a current active session, choose Add to My Plans.
If This overlaps another plan appears, review the named conflicts. Select Add anyway only if you intend that overlap, or Cancel to leave the new session unplanned.
Open My Plans and check the Programme/service name, date and time before relying on your plan.
Check the provider’s current eligibility, fees, availability and registration process, and arrange attendance directly with the provider.
notes: The Guide cannot book a seat or contact the provider for you.
To remove your personal plan, use Remove from My Plans. This does not cancel a provider booking.
If a save reports an error, check My Plans before retrying. If no active session is available, check current dates with the provider rather than assuming a saved listing has bookable sessions.

facts.title: Add a saved activity session to My Plans
keywords: add a session to my plans
how do i plan a session
facts.message: Save the Offering first, then open Care Calendar and choose Calendar. On an active session, choose Add to My Plans. If it overlaps another plan, review the conflict warning before deciding whether to add it anyway. My Plans records intended attendance only; it is not a provider booking or registration. Confirm attendance with the provider.

facts.title: Plans are not bookings
facts.message: A personal plan records intended attendance. It is not a booking, registration, or confirmation from the provider. Check the provider’s current details and contact them when registration is needed.

facts.title: Who planned a provider Programme
keywords: members who added my programme to my plans
how many people planned my service
facts.message: The Guide cannot show a provider who added its Programme/service to My Plans, how many people planned it, or a member or attendee list. My Plans is private to each signed-in account; the Calendar read and removal paths check that account. A personal plan is not a registration or verified attendance record. Ask the provider about its own registration process if an official attendance list is needed, without putting member details in Guide chat.
